name: transfer_item
description: Transfers an item from one character or NPC's equipment to another's. Removes from the source first, then adds to the destination.

from_entity.description: Slug or UUID of the source character or NPC.

to_entity.description: Slug or UUID of the destination character or NPC.

item.description: Exact item string to transfer (must match an entry in the source's equipment list).
